kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic אֲצִיצָא (ʾăṣīṣā, “pot”). Compare Hebrew עציץ (atsíts, “flowerpot”).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: صِيصِيَة • (ṣīṣiya) f (plural صَيَاصٍ (ṣayāṣin, construct state صَيَاصِي (ṣayāṣī)))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Borrowed from Aramaic צִיצִיתָא (ṣīṣīṯā), צִיצְתָא (ṣīṣəṯā), derivates of a צִיצָא (ṣīṣā), equalling English tzitzit. The closest meaning is attested in Old Armenian ցից (cʻicʻ).
g: anything projected apt for picking or getting hold of things, a pale, picket, palisade, or horn or spur of a beast
